queries_run: Garmin distribution channel shift OR direct-to-consumer OR subscription business model 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：Garmin 通路以獨立零售商、經銷商、OEM 等間接通路為主，另有 garmin.com、連網服務訂閱與自有門市等直營管道；2025 年直營通路淨銷售占總淨銷售超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: Garmin also sells its products and services directly through the Garmin online webshop (garmin.com), subscriptions for connected services, and Garmin retail stores. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct distribution channels accounted for greater than 10% of total net sales.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未見 2026 年通路重大改組公告；搜尋摘要稱訂閱（Connect+）占比仍小（Q4 2025 財報電話會議稱 ratable 收入低於 10%）、TruMed HSA/FSA 為新直銷管道、Q3 2026 CEO 稱 Connect+ 成長快於相關產品線，但摘要為轉述、無可逐字原文，僅列 clues。

clues.claim: Q4 2025 財報電話會議：ratable 訂閱與服務收入仍低於總營收 10%，Connect+ 轉換率高。
Q3 2026 財報電話會議：CEO 稱 Garmin Connect+ 成長快於其支撐的產品線。
